//: The survivor village's small economy. Seven shelves (29.09.2026): Ilse's watch post keeps a little of everything, Mara the stores, Bex the kitchen, Dr. Sokol the infirmary, Anselm tools, metal and the chemistry of the forge, Piotr electronics, Juno the archive's rarest instruments and books; each sells from its own pool, and the rarer the thing is to come by otherwise, the higher its tier. Original Prologue numbers; the ids name whitelisted things. Every offer has a 'tier' (common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary). A merchant fills 'slots' places a day from 'pool' and 'rareSlots' from 'rare': each place first rolls a tier by 'tiers' weight (among the tiers that list holds), then an offer of that tier by its own 'weight' - seeded by run, merchant and day, so a reload cannot re-roll it. 'price' is in dollar coins per unit ('unit' charges of a charge-counted item, else one piece), never below the tier's 'minPrice'; 'count' is how many units are on the shelf. What is sold stays sold until the next day. Buying from the survivor (decided 29.09.2026): the village buys FOOD only, and only in the kitchen (Bex) - nothing that has no calories, no medicine, no parts. Never rotten food, never more than a merchant's 'purse' a day, never more than 'dailyCap' coins a day across the whole village, and each further helping of the same thing that day is worth 'appetiteFalloff' of the one before, down to 'appetiteFloor'.

food.//: What food is worth when sold: kcal / kcalPerDollar, times complexity, enjoyment and freshness. Complexity: 'found' for food no recipe makes, else base + perDifficulty x recipe difficulty + perComponent x component rows, capped. Enjoyment: 1 + fun x perFun, clamped. Freshness: full price down to 'freshFrom' of shelf life left, then falling to 'staleFactor' just before it turns. Drinks with no calories are not food. 'findValue' (29.09.2026): food that was found rather than made is worth at most this many coins for everything one find of it holds (the most generous loot entry or carcass), by how rare the find is - a common find is worth nothing four times in five and a coin the fifth, only an epic or legendary one about two.

seasons.//: The shelf by season (26.09.2026): in winter what burns, what keeps and what is warm costs more at the shelf, and the village pays more for what burns and for fresh food it cannot grow; in autumn it lays in fuel and food that keeps. 'sell' multiplies the shelf's price, 'buy' what a merchant pays. '@fuel' is the list below; '@keepingFood' is food that keeps keepingFoodDays or more (or never spoils), '@freshFood' food that turns within freshFoodDays, '@warmClothes' a garment of warmClothesMin warmth or more. Code: src/game/village/Trade.js seasonFactor.

tiers.//: Shelf tiers: 'weight' is how often a place on the shelf rolls that tier, 'minPrice' the least one unit of it costs.
